categories.evidence: Carries the Tests label and adds reusable unit test utilities (src/test/util/block_validity.cpp/.h) alongside comprehensive block validation suites.
categories.rationale: Adds critical unit-level coverage for consensus failure modes across multiple block validation entry points.
